title: Printing Text, Numbers, and Multiple Values Quiz
description: Check your understanding of print(), strings, numbers, commas, and plus signs.

questions.question: What is the exact output of the following two statements?
questions.explanation: + joins the strings directly, while the comma prints values with a space between them.

questions.question: What type of error will Python raise if you execute print(Hello) without defining Hello first?
questions.explanation: Without quotes, Python treats Hello as a variable name. If it is not defined, Python raises NameError.
